high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from The Indian Express website, specifically from the "Bangalore" section under the "Cities" category. The headline reads: "Former Karnataka BJP minister B C Patil’s son-in-law dies allegedly by suicide." The subheading states that BJP leader B C Patil told reporters that Pratap Kumar was depressed due to the couple not having children. The article is dated July 9, 2024, at 12:04 IST, and it is attributed to the "Express News Service." There is a NewsGuard verification badge indicating the reliability of the news source.
